summary: Re-review of round 1. Most round-1 findings are really fixed. Mix balance: lead -4.2...-5.3 LU, bass -7.3...-9.5 LU, 60-150 Hz share 25-37 %, race hooks +3.1...+6.9 dB over their masker. Race songs: 64-68-bar, 2-minute loops with 8-bar bass lines, solo, breakdown and rotating fills. Stingers: in the song's key, on its 8th/beat grid, ducking the music. Race start: the A downbeat is cued to GO. KO: boom +8.6 dB over the kicks, announcer at the peak, barks wait for the cinematic to end. Adaptive music: +1-2.5 dB at top-3, final stretch with build, key lift and tempo lift. The title theme now carries into the menus. Boost spam is culled. Wall, scrape, ULT launch and projectile-miss sounds are wired. Pause/settings keep the race song, dead code is gone, tsc is clean for the audio files, and the harmony is literate. BUT a new blocker sits under all of it. Every persistent voice's envelope (dsp/env.ts retrigger path) starts ramping at the END OF THE PREVIOUS ENVELOPE instead of at the note. As a result, hats, shakers, snare wires, claps and the kick/slap clicks play reversed. Every Rhodes chord, bass note, lead phrase and stinger after a rest pre-sounds the previous pitches for up to the lookahead (180 ms; a full beat for stingers) and starts with a jump. The bass is audible 180 ms before GO. The same flaw turns every 0.8-1.2 s song crossfade into an instant ~-18 dB cut. The audio thread also still costs 8-10 % against the 5 % budget (round-1 T3, not addressed). tools/audio-check.mjs passes offline. The in-game part failed once on the race-load gap (900 ms) at machine load 153 and passed (0 ms) at load 7, so that check is flaky under load, not a regression. Evidence: shots/review/audio/r2-music/: env-retrigger.json, inst-retrigger.png, wav-rhodes-pre.wav, wav-sting-pre.wav, coast-hats-envelope.png, ingame-mountain-hats.png, load-mountain1/2.wav + *-go.png, wav-fadeout.wav, cpu-realtime.json, harmony-r2.json, wav-finish-drop.wav, intensity-coast.json, audio-check*.log, lab-1-city.png, flow-1-menu.png, ko-coast.png, ult-coast.png.

issues.title: Persistent-voice envelopes ramp up from the end of the previous note: reversed hats/snares, pre-sounded wrong pitches before every chord and stinger, hard-cut song changes
issues.detail:
Cause: dsp/env.ts begin(p, t, retrigger=true) only calls holdAt(p, t), i.e. cancelAndHoldAtTime(t). When the voice's last envelope has already ended (its final linearRamp to 0 lies before t), the Web Audio spec inserts NO event at t. The next linearRampToValueAtTime(peak, t+attack) therefore ramps from that OLD event. Measured in Chromium (env-retrigger.json): a retriggered adsr whose note starts at 1.0 s already reads gain 0.46 at 0.6 s and 0.86 at 0.9 s; the fresh-node control reads 0. The same happens in real instruments (inst-retrigger.png): 8th-note hats rise for ~160 ms and stop at the onset, and a bass or wah-lead note after a 0.6 s rest swells in for ~0.5 s at the PREVIOUS pitch. Realtime consequences:
(1) Hats, shaker, tambourine, snare wires, clap, ride and the kick/tom/slap clicks (all NoiseVoice or holdAt+ramp) play reverse envelopes. In game the mountain 8th hats are sawtooth reverse swells (ingame-mountain-hats.png), and the coast snare wires swell ~130 ms into every backbeat (coast-kickclick-envelope.png).
(2) Rhodes, clav, pad, brass, lead and bass jump in at scheduling time, up to 0.18 s early, with the old pitch. Two Rhodes chords scheduled like the game (wav-rhodes-pre.wav): before an F#-A#-C#-E chord the 120-500 Hz band jumps 35 dB at scheduling time and plays A3 (the 220 Hz init pitch of unused pool voices) plus C4/E4 from the previous chord, louder than the chord itself.
(3) Stingers land on the 8th/beat grid, so they pre-sound longer (wav-sting-pre.wav). ONE MORE is preceded by 110 ms of an A3 drone at +5 dB over the stinger. FINISH is preceded by 160 ms of the previous stinger's chord, in game too (ingame-stinger-finish.png).
(4) Race start: the bass plays the vamp's A2 ~180 ms before the GO downbeat, offline (wav-gosync-mountain.wav, wav-gs-bass.wav) and in game (load-mountain1/2-go.png).
(5) Band.fade has the same flaw, so SongPlayer.stop()'s 0.8 s fade is an instant cut. Offline (wav-fadeout.wav) the level drops -17 -> -35 dB within 25 ms, gain = 1 - 5.98/6.78 = 0.118 as the ramp-from-old-event maths predicts. In game, title -> race (load-mountain1.wav 4.575 -> 4.600 s) goes -19 -> -37 dB and leaves a 0.4 s hole before the race song fades in. The unit's click detector misses all of this: it has an absolute 0.03 threshold and the jumps are masked in full mixes.
issues.fix:
Anchor every retriggered segment at its start time:
- In env.ts, keep a WeakMap<AudioParam, number> of each param's envelope end, written by perc()/adsr(); every envelope ends at exactly 0. In begin(): if t >= end, call p.setValueAtTime(0, t), because the voice is idle. Otherwise cancelAndHoldAtTime already rewrote the running ramp to end at t.
- Do the same in DrumKit.clap/tambourine and the Lead breath ramps.
- In Band.fade, record the last target and call setValueAtTime(lastTarget, at) before the ramp.
- Open each Gate at the note time, not at scheduling time.
- Add an audio-check regression: for each persistent instrument, render two hits 0.6 s apart, a stinger after 5 s idle, and a song stop with fade 0.8. Assert < -60 dB in the 150 ms before each onset, and that the fade-out is still above -3 dB 100 ms in.

issues.title: Audio-thread CPU still ~2x the 5 % budget (round-1 T3 not addressed)
issues.detail: Measured with CDP WebAudio renderCapacity on the realtime context (probe-cpu.mjs -> cpu-realtime.json; 1920x1080, coast race on autopilot, 142 fps, machine load ~7 on 10 cores). Race: median 8.0 %, p90 10.5 %. Final stretch (intensity 2): median 10.1 %, p90 14.8 %. Music stopped (sfx + bike loops only): 4.4 %. The brief's bar is total CPU < 5 %. Fix round 1 orders T3 but has no checkpoint for it. The only CPU-motivated change found is the mono 1.1 s music reverb.
issues.fix:
Add a renderCapacity gate to tools/audio-check.mjs (menu, race, intensity 2, busy pack). Then cut voices:
- Rhodes pool 6 -> 4 voices (it plays 4-note chords).
- Brass 2x5 saws -> 2x3.
- Build the lead2 octave double only at intensity >= 1.
- Share one delay and one reverb send per song instead of per band; stingers reuse the song's.
- Drop the per-voice StereoPanners in Brass.
- Re-measure on an idle machine.

issues.title: Finish line: the final-stretch music collapses back to section A in the home key under the FINISH fanfare; the same victory cues play for 1st and 8th
issues.detail: flow.ts sets session.phase = 'finished' as soon as the player crosses the line. watcher.ts update() then targets intensity 0 (phase !== 'racing'), so SongPlayer.setIntensity -> pendingForm 'main' -> switchForm(false) fires at the next bar line. The result is a crash, section A from the top, a whole step lower, -4 % tempo and -2 dB, while the FINISH stinger (built in the lifted key) is still ringing. In wav-finish-drop.wav the band is back in A major by 9.16 s under the B-major fanfare tail, and RMS falls -13.4 -> -17.5 dB once the duck releases, about 1 s before the results crossfade (END_DELAY 3 s). FINISH (bVI-bVII-I fanfare) and the 'Victory Lap' results song are identical for every place; only the announcer line differs.
issues.fix: Once the player has finished, freeze the form and intensity (no switchForm) until the results crossfade, or play a 2-bar outro tag in the lifted key. Pick place-dependent cues: the fanfare for places 1-3, and a shorter deflated cadence (e.g. bVI-V-i or the BUSTED slide) for 4-8. Give the results song a variant (e.g. start in its B section in minor) for a bad place.

issues.title: Top-3 adaptive layers switch on any 16th, with no hysteresis
issues.detail: SongPlayer.setIntensity() sets this.intensity immediately and tokenAt() reads it for every scheduled 16th. The top-3 layers (cowbell/shaker, claps, 16th clav, brass answers, octave-doubled hook) therefore start or stop mid-bar or mid-phrase. watcher.ts recomputes the target every frame from p.place with no hold time, so a 3<->4 pack battle toggles them back and forth. One 90 s autopilot race already had 11 player place changes (intensity-coast.json). Only the final-stretch form switch is bar-quantized.
issues.fix: Apply 0<->1 changes at the next bar line (better: the next 2-bar boundary), the same way pendingForm is handled. In watcher.ts require the new place for >= 2 s before changing the target.

issues.title: Voice lines: round-1 problems only partly fixed (7 s sloth barks, hot countdown words, thin roster coverage)
issues.detail: Fixed: bark gain/pan now follow the speaker, and barks no longer duck the music. Unchanged in public/assets/voice: sloth_taunt_1 7.34 s, sloth_ko_1 6.84 s, sloth_taunt_0 3.44 s, sloth_hurt_0 3.33 s, pigeon_hurt_1 3.03 s. A 7 s bark blocks every other bark for ~8.6 s (BARK_GAP after busy). ann_1 and ann_go measure RMS -10.7 dB against -15.5...-17.0 dB for the other announcer lines, so the countdown still jumps ~+5 dB. Roster coverage (voice-coverage.mjs): only 2-3 of 12 taunts and 1-2 of 6 KO/hurt lines per character have clips; the rest fall back to the animal call.
issues.fix: Regenerate the sloth lines in tools/gen-tts.mjs at speed >= 0.75 with pauses trimmed (<= 2.5 s). RMS-match clips shorter than 0.4 s to the announcer set. Generate the remaining roster lines on the next IOA-VPN run, which also refreshes src/data/voice.ts.

issues.title: Title / menu / results still ~60 s loops on one-bar bass and comp ostinatos
issues.detail: Only the race songs were rewritten. menu: 32 bars (64 s), the bass is the 1-bar WALK and COMP for all 32 bars. results: 32 bars (63 s), 1-bar BASS and COMP throughout. title: 32 bars (61 s), its B section repeats one bass bar 8 times. Since the M7 fix, the 61 s title loop also covers career, garage, track select, settings, how-to and credits until the first race, so browsing the garage for 3 minutes hears it three times.
issues.fix: Give each menu song 8-bar bass lines per section, comp variations, and a B2/solo or breakdown section (>= 2 min per loop), as done for the race songs.

issues.title: Harmony nits: menu b9 over Gm7b5 unfixed; new clash in the city A4 ending
issues.detail:
harmony.mjs on the real compiled data (harmony-r2.json):
- menu A2 bar 6 beat 2 and B bar 5 beat 3 (a quarter note): Ab5 = b9 over Gm7b5, whose Rhodes voicing holds A natural. Unchanged from round 1.
- New: race-city A4 bar 8 beat 4: C6 held a quarter over Db7#11, whose voicing has Cb (a major 7th over a dominant). It comes from the rewritten A4 ending.
- title A2/A3 bar 6 beat 2: F5 over A7#9 against the voiced E.
Race coast and mountain are now clean, apart from passing 8ths on the and-of-4.
issues.fix: menu: use A5 or Bb5 on those beats (or move Ab5 off the beat). city A4: end B5-Ab5 over Db7#11 and land C6 on the next downbeat (Cm9). title: E5 on beat 2 of bar 6.

issues.title: Cymbals are plain filtered noise in a 16 kHz-bandwidth context with a mono reverb: hissy, narrow top end
issues.detail:
Sources:
- music/instruments/drums.ts: crash = white noise HP 4.2 kHz + peak 7.6 kHz; hats = noise HP 7.2 kHz + peak 10.5 kHz; ride = noise HP 6.5 kHz + one 4.63 kHz sine.
- engine.ts AUDIO_RATE = 32000: nothing above 16 kHz.
- The music reverb is a mono 1.1 s plate.
Next to commercial synth-funk / P5-style mixes, the top end lacks metallic partials, shimmer and stereo air.
issues.fix: Build hats and crash from 6 detuned square oscillators at inharmonic ratios (808-style) -> band-pass + HP with velocity-dependent decay, and the ride bell from 2-3 inharmonic partials. Use a stereo reverb: two decorrelated mono IRs hard-panned, or a small FDN. Revisit 44.1/48 kHz once the CPU issue is solved.

issues.title: cross-unit: grade stamp / count / pause UI sounds never fire
issues.detail: src/ui calls only ui.move, ui.confirm, ui.back, ui.cutin (pause and results slams) and ui.coin. ui.stamp, ui.count, ui.pause and ui.unlock (sfx/ui-bike.ts) have no caller, so the results grade stamp lands silently. The audio side now covers the skill/SHOWTIME cut-ins and the KO slash itself. police.whistle is still a direct sfx() call from race/police.ts.
issues.fix: ui-screens: sfx('ui.stamp') on the grade stamp, sfx('ui.count') per count-up tick, sfx('ui.pause') when pause opens. race: emit a whistle event so audio can place it at the corgi.
